## Combo 3875-5702--131

Color identity: G | Bracket: Exhibition | Popularity: 93917 | Commander: legal | Mana needed: {2}{G} plus enough mana to animate the land
Produces: Infinite landfall triggers; Infinite tapped land tokens
Requires: Man-Land that Enters Untapped (battlefield)
Start: Springheart Nantuko (battlefield); Tireless Provisioner (battlefield)
Prerequisites: You have a land card in hand.
  You are able to play a land this turn.
Steps: Animate the land.
  Cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to the animated land.
  Play any land.
  When the land enters the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko and Tireless Provisioner trigger.
  Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating a Treasure token.
  Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}.
  Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of the land it is attached to.
  When the land token enters the battlefield, Tireless Provisioner and Springheart Nantuko trigger.
  Holding priority, activate the land token by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
  Repeat from step 5.

Color identity: G | Bracket: Exhibition | Popularity: 12688 | Commander: legal
Produces: Infinite creature ETB; Infinite creature LTB; Infinite colored mana; Infinite death triggers; Infinite creature sacrifice triggers
Requires: Persist Creature (battlefield)
Start: Phyrexian Altar (battlefield); The Great Henge (battlefield)
Steps: Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the persist creature, adding one mana of any color.
  The sacrificed creature's persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
  The Great Henge triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature and causing you to draw a card.
  The -1/-1 and +1/+1 counters are removed as a state-based action.
  Repeat.

## Combo 4178-5702

  Play a land.
  When the land enters the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of the Forest it is attached to.
  When the Forest token enter the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers.
  Holding priority, activate the Forest token by tapping it, adding {G}.
  Nissa triggers, adding {G}.
  Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of the Forest it is attached to.
  Repeat from step 6.
Notes: The cost in step 6 can possibly be covered by the land played in step 5 on the first iteration, if the land is a Forest that enters untapped. This would make the starting cost of the combo {0}.
